rysh import warp — preview (nothing is written without --apply)

Layout: 3 tab(s), 3 lane(s), 5 pane(s)
  tab 1 "docs"
    lane 1
      pane 1  cwd: $HOME/Documents
              start: ls -la
  tab 2 "app"
    lane 1
      pane 1  cwd: $HOME/src/app
              start: npm install; npm start
      pane 2  cwd: $HOME/src/app
              start: npm test -- --watch
      pane 3  cwd: /srv/logs
  tab 3 "second window"
    lane 1
      pane 1  cwd: /tmp
  Start commands are not run now: they run when you run the generated script.

Notes:
  - 2 Warp windows were merged into one rysh session's tabs, in order
  - tab "app": a split nested inside a lane was flattened into that lane (rysh lanes stack panes top to bottom)

With --apply this writes (after backing up what it replaces):
  .rysh/imports/warp-dev.rysh
Undo with: rysh import --undo
